title: Team Talk: Handling Requests at Work · 新情境写作
instructions: 独立写至少80词。再按真实反馈订正；不要照抄源文。同一提示再次使用属于订正或巩固，不冒充未见任务。
prompt:
Write 5–7 simple sentences about your work or study this week. Use have to, must, or can, and use the present and past tense. Example: On Monday I had to finish a report. I can help my team on Friday.
Write at least 80 words. Use your own new details. Do not copy the source text.
